meta.name: Atlas Expansion Pack

meta.description: Massive multi-extension bundle combining a command center plugin, navigation patch, adaptive theme, and data seeds for stress-testing expansion handling.

meta.name: Navigation Patch
meta.description: Adds a nav ribbon and hotkeys for jumping between boards, backlog, and focus view.

meta.name: Aurora Deck Theme

meta.name: Project Atlas Seeds
meta.description: Adds demo cards, tags, and list structure to quickly visualize the atlas workflow.
